data.name: Master Poisoner
data.description: An enchanting courtesan can use Craft (alchemy) to change a poison's type. This requires 1 hour of work with an alchemist's lab and a Craft (alchemy) skill check (DC = the poison's save DC). If he's successful, the poison's type changes to contact, ingested, inhaled, or injury. If he fails the check, the poison is ruined. The enchanting courtesan receives a +%1 bonus on Craft (alchemy) skill checks when working with poison.|EnchantingCourtesanLVL/2
